sentence: This project supports laboratory research in molecular virology and the ways viruses cause disease.
This project studies the many roles of a protein linked to cancer, microcephaly and infertility, using 3D X-Ray imaging and artificial intelligence.
This project tests and improves immunoassays that check the safety and efficiency of genome editing in human clinical trials.
This project is a cancer cell biology research program on signal transduction and chemical biology.
This project studies how tissue reacts to implanted biomaterials so that the foreign body response and implant failure can be prevented.
This project studies how hepatocytes and skeletal myocytes shape the immune response to proteins encoded by mRNA in lipid nanoparticles.
This project studies how a metabolic enzyme pushes fibroblasts from helping regeneration to causing fibrosis in pulmonary fibrosis.
This project studies how the structure of ion channels determines their function and how cell membrane lipid composition affects this.
This project tests whether an engineered protein derived from mycoplasma can block inhibitors of protein replacement therapy in patients with rare genetic disorders.
This project tests whether matching donor red blood cells to patients with sickle cell disease by genotype improves transfusion outcomes.
This project studies how biomolecular condensates help drive oncogenic signaling and tumor growth in lung cancer.
This project uses a system to study heart function and the effects of drugs on the heart.
This project tests whether a deep learning algorithm can help find targetable cancer drivers in neuroblastoma in children.
This project provides statistical and bioinformatics support for laboratory, translational and clinical research on leukemia.
This project studies how an enzyme that modifies chromatin affects gene regulation in cocaine substance use disorder.
This project provides services for making genetically engineered mouse models used to study human cancer.
This project builds a method that uses pulsed light to stimulate mechanosensitive and thermosensitive ion channels without touching them.
This project studies early steps of myeloma and how genomic signatures and the effective age of bone marrow affect the risk of developing it.
This project studies how retroviral intasomes insert viral DNA into chromatin and nucleosomes, using biochemistry and structural biology.
This project tests whether the formation of ceramide is needed for proper microvascular function.
